references.text: In Proverbs 11:29 it is mentioned how the one who brings trouble upon their own house will inherit wind, which can be seen in connection with inner darkness and its consequences.
Proverbs 28:22 speaks of a person with an evil eye in a context of greed, which may relate to the inner darkness mentioned in Matthew 6:23.
Psalm 119:105 describes God's word as a lamp for the feet and a light on the path, contrasting the idea of inner light versus darkness.
